confidenceNote_criticalDiscrepancy: The two Tariff Sheets and the Sunworld Contract Letter give MATERIALLY DIFFERENT figures and even different room-category structures for both properties, all nominally covering the same 2025/2026 period. Tariff Sheets use Single/Double/Triple by room name (Deluxe/Junior/Senior Suite for Nakuru; Luxury Tent for Naivasha) with a 2-season split (Low/High). The Sunworld Letter uses Single/Double/Triple/Junior Suite(2pax)/Senior Suite(2pax) for Nakuru with a 4-period split, and Single/Double/Triple only for Naivasha - and its actual dollar figures for equivalent categories are lower than the Tariff Sheets (e.g. Nakuru Deluxe/Standard Single: Tariff Sheet Low $220 vs Sunworld Letter low-equivalent period 01/04-30/06 $124; High season Tariff Sheet $330 vs Sunworld Letter equivalent period $234-245). Both sources are reproduced in full below, clearly separated - do NOT merge or average them. Confirm directly with the properties/Sunworld which is the currently governing rate before quoting.
